Remark
Source: topping:page-0108, topping:page-0109 1. ch9:4.2,ch9:4.3\group curvature-pinching Each $u_t$ is a fibrewise isometry. Thus the induced fibre metric $h$ on $V$ is time-independent, $A(t)$ is compatible with $h$, and $Au=Ah=0$.
